📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-04-crm-amqp-consumer-monitor-family-quiet-period-flap`
This is occurrence #18 in the last 7 days (137th overall). Posting now — last posted 2026-08-16T13:05:31Z, ~38h45m ago, past the 24h suppression window.
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `CRM Experience` (`@crm-experience` / `#team-crm-experience`)
Playbook: 1) Confirm monitor ID is one of the 5 team:crm AMQP-consumer siblings. 2) Pull the service's trace.amqp.command.hits rate over a multi-hour window — expect a genuine but brief dip below the monitor's floor, not a data-gap/tool failure. 3) Confirm service status:error logs return 0. 4) Check sibling monitors for co-firing — if all OK, likely the benign quiet-period pattern. 5) Escalate only if still unresolved after ~1h or a sibling error/latency monitor co-fires.
Open Jira: n/a — none filed (fix_status: monitoring-noise-suspected-unconfirmed)

Root-cause analysis:
  • Query: `sum:trace.amqp.command.hits{service:runtime-core-subscriber,env:prod}.as_rate()`, window 03:20:31–04:20:31Z
  • Observed: 179 points, min 0.05 msg/s (below the ~2 msg/s floor for 59/179 points), max 226.7 msg/s (fast recovery burst within the same window)
  • `service:runtime-core-subscriber status:error` DD Logs, same window: 0 hits
  • No sibling co-fire evidence in this cycle's monitor-diff scan (302055141 also fired this cycle, but at a later timestamp — processed as its own group)
  • Shape matches the documented benign quiet-period pattern: genuine sub-floor metric dip, zero errors, fast self-recovery

Source alerts (1 total, degraded mode — no Slack MCP this session):
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/302057011 (last_triggered 2026-08-18T03:50:31+00:00, OK/recovery by scan time)

Corroborate independently:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/302057011
  • DD metric explorer: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.amqp.command.hits&exp_scope=service%3Aruntime-core-subscriber%2Cenv%3Aprod&exp_agg=avg&start=1787023231&end=1787026831
  • DD APM traces: https://app.datadoghq.com/apm/traces?query=service%3Aruntime-core-subscriber%20env%3Aprod&start=1787023231000&end=1787026831000
  • Kibana: 0 hits in window (not the evidence datasource for this KB — evidence_source: datadog_apm)

Full investigation: docs/investigations/2026-08-18-625ff5e5c18f629a.md

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-03-eda-consumer-amqp-stopped-publishing`
This is occurrence #6 in the last 7 days (54th overall). Posting now — last posted 2026-08-17T10:39:27Z, ~24h16m ago, past the 24h suppression window.
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Integrations` (`@integrations` / `#team-integrations`)
Playbook: 1) Confirm shape: DD monitor 296641466 in 'No Data'/Alert. 2) ALWAYS check sibling P1 monitors first — 296632224 (Event ingest stopped) and 296636101 (Kafka events stopped) — if both OK, core EDA pipeline is healthy and this is very unlikely user-impacting. 3) Confirm service:eda_consumer status:error in DD Logs returns 0. 4) If sibling monitors are also firing, escalate immediately. 5) Do not treat as actionable on a single occurrence.
Open Jira: n/a — none filed (fix_status: escalated-for-review)

Root-cause analysis:
  • Query: `sum:trace.amqp.command.hits{service:eda_consumer,env:prod}.as_count()`, window 10:25:26–11:25:26Z
  • Observed: 8 points, min 1.0 max 2.0, sum 15.0 — continuous low-level publish activity, brief sub-threshold dip rather than a sustained stall
  • `service:eda_consumer status:error` DD Logs, same window: 0 hits
  • Sibling P1 monitors both OK: 296632224 (Event ingest stopped) and 296636101 (Kafka events stopped) — core EDA pipeline healthy per the KB entry's playbook step 2
  • Shape matches the documented benign quiet-period pattern (54 prior occurrences, same mechanism)

Source alerts (1 total, degraded mode — no Slack MCP this session):
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/296641466 (last_triggered 2026-08-18T10:55:26+00:00, OK/recovery by scan time)

Corroborate independently:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/296641466
  • DD metric explorer: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.amqp.command.hits&exp_scope=service%3Aeda_consumer%2Cenv%3Aprod&exp_agg=sum&start=1787048726&end=1787052326
  • Sibling monitors (both OK): https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/296632224 | https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/296636101
  • Kibana: 0 hits in window (not the evidence datasource for this KB — evidence_source: datadog_apm)

Full investigation: docs/investigations/2026-08-18-9da27c37b68767da.md

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-28-mobile-asyncstorage-securestore-keychain`
This is occurrence #21 (36-day quiet gap since last fire on 2026-07-13).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin` (`@admin` / `#team-admin`)
Playbook: Client-side iOS keychain migration bug (Method/2.x app: AsyncStorage->SecureStore migration fails with ERR_KEY_CHAIN). No server-side fix — route to mobile team. Server-side action: none beyond monitoring volume.
Open Jira: n/a — fix_jira not set
